name: Grill Me
description: Launches a relentless, round-by-round interview that stress-tests a plan or design until every decision is settled.
longDescription: A manual-only entry point (`disable-model-invocation: true`, so the agent never triggers it on its own) that hands off to the `/grilling` skill. The interview maps your plan as a **design tree**, asks the whole open frontier of questions each round (numbered, each with a recommended answer), looks up facts itself via sub-agents instead of asking you, and stops only when nothing is left silently assumed. Install `/grilling` alongside it; this skill contains nothing else.
